'''2016 European Championship Day 2 Rasmus Juul LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Rasmus Juul]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Rasmus Juul]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open WYS Juul LS 2016 EC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
